title: Bills of Lading and Transport Documents: when an approved document may be issued
content:
## Scope

This Bills of Lading and Transport Documents policy governs the issuance of an approved transport document: the shipped-on-board basis, the prepaid freight hold, the issuance fee and the originals put into circulation.

## Formal clauses

1. An approved document is issued once the cargo has been shipped on board. It is issued only after the booking's containers are loaded, or when they are already gated in on a tier that permits received-for-shipment issuance. The booking status is read from the booking record: loaded, departed or closed qualify on every tier; gated in qualifies only on a permitting tier.
2. The line issues within the tier's issuance service standard, counted in hours after departure.
3. On a tier that requires prepaid freight to be settled before issuance, a booking with prepaid freight must show freight charges due of 0.00 on the booking record before issuance, unless the documentation party is credit-approved and the tier exempts credit-approved customers from that requirement.
4. Collect-freight bookings are never held at issuance for freight.
5. Issuance charges the tier's issuance fee once for the set and, on every tier except the AHL Sea Waybill, puts the tier's number of originals for the set into circulation.
6. The issuance fee may be booked only on a document whose status is issued.
7. A set is charged at most once; a second issuance fee for the same document and the same set is not booked.

## Prepaid hold, as a truth table

Applies only on a tier that requires prepaid settlement before issuance.

| Freight terms on the booking | Booking freight charges due | Documentation party credit-approved and tier exempts credit customers | Held at issuance for freight? |
|---|---|---|---|
| Collect | any | any | No, never |
| Prepaid | 0.00 | any | No |
| Prepaid | above 0.00 | yes | No |
| Prepaid | above 0.00 | no | Yes, not issued until the charges due show 0.00 |

On a tier that does not require prepaid settlement before issuance, clause 3 imposes no hold.

## Points of judgement

- **Hypothetical case:** the booking record shows the containers gated in but not loaded. The document may be issued only if its tier permits received-for-shipment issuance; otherwise it is not issued before the containers are loaded.
- The credit status is taken from the documentation party's customer record, and the freight terms and charges due from the booking record, as they stand before issuance.
